title: Cancellation of one split top differential
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $B$ be an integer-indexed cochain complex of $\mathcal O_S$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] supported in $[0,m+1]$ for $m\in\mathbf N$. Suppose its terms are quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], of finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-finite-type-affine], and flat over $\mathrm{id}_S$ [def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. If $B^m\to B^{m+1}$ has a right inverse, there is a cochain complex $D$ supported in $[0,m]$, with all three termwise properties, and a chain homotopy equivalence $D\simeq B$ (chain maps inverse up to degree-minus-one homotopies).

source.place: Tags 068V, 068U, 00NX and 00MT; explicit finite-projective split cancellation argument, expanded by F2

proof.text: Use the actual canonical truncation D=B.truncLE m. It has the required two support bounds. In every degree construct a retract of B.X n: below m use truncLEXIso, at m use the split projection id - δ≫section δ to cycles and truncLEXIsoCycles, above m use the zero object.

Apply the proved sheaf-retract properties theorem to every degree. Assemble its flatness, quasi-coherence and finite-presentation conclusions with the support bounds and the canonical truncation homotopy theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_split_top_differential_cancellation (S : Scheme.{u})
    (B : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ) (m : ℕ)
    (hBge : B.IsStrictlyGE 0) (hBle : B.IsStrictlyLE (m + 1 : ℕ))
    (hBflat : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S))
    (hBqc : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hBfp : ∀ n : ℤ, (B.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hsplit : IsSplitEpi (B.d (m : ℤ) (m + 1 : ℕ))) :
    ∃ D : CochainComplex S.Modules ℤ,
      D.IsStrictlyGE 0 ∧ D.IsStrictlyLE m ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFlatOver (𝟙 S)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, (D.X n).IsFinitePresentation) ∧
      Nonempty (HomotopyEquiv D B)
